messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick q — heading to Berlin for the offsite + Euro conf next month. Any flight/hotel/transport hacks people swear by?
Emma García: Book your train from BER on the DB Navigator app early, prices jump. FEX is fastest to Hbf but I usually take RE for reliability.
Raj Patel: +1 on DB app. Also check hand-luggage rules — smaller EU carriers have weird sizes.
Mike Thompson: If anyone's routing via FRA, try to book lounges if you have long layovers, worth it. Also bring a foldable daypack.
Sasha Ivanov: Pro tip: buy a BVG 24h ticket if you plan >3 metro/tram rides. Can get it from the BVG app or machines.
Emma García: For hotels — ask for a room on a higher floor away from the street if you’re sensitive to noise. Sometimes mention it in advance and they help.
Raj Patel: Bring a small power strip + EU adapter (Type C/E). Hotels usually have 1 outlet by the desk only.
Mike Thompson: If you need local data, order an eSIM before you land. Otherwise pick up a prepaid SIM at the airport kiosks.
Olivia Chen: Any restaurant recs for team dinner? Prefer something casual, veggie-friendly.
Sasha Ivanov: Katz Orange is chill and very veggie-friendly. calendar-bot booked it for Wed 19:00 — will share confirmation. :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Reservation confirmed: Katz Orange — 10 ppl — Wed 19:00.
Emma García: For luggage: use a cheap TSA-style luggage lock and put a change of clothes in carry-on in case bags delay.
Raj Patel: Heads up on time zones: give yourself one evening free when you arrive to reset. Jet lag = no fun during workshops.
Mike Thompson: Expense tip — take quick photos of receipts and upload to Expensify right away. Meal per diems can get messy otherwise.
Sasha Ivanov: If anyone wants to split airport rides, post in here when flights are firm. I’m arriving BER 09:40 on 4/12.
Olivia Chen: I land 08:10 same day — happy to grab a cab share if someone else lands similar.
Emma García: Also: bring a reusable water bottle — tap water is fine and saves cash.
Raj Patel: One last thing: check conference bag for swag weight limits if flying budget. I once had to mail stuff home.
Mike Thompson: 😂 been there. Also carry a tiny sewing kit for wardrobe emergencies.
Olivia Chen: Amazing, thanks all. If folks want a quick poll on arrival day + airport rides I can post one tomorrow.
Sasha Ivanov: Please do. I’m in for shared ride. :raised_hands:
Emma García: Me too.
Raj Patel: Count me in for ride-share and dinner.
calendar-bot: Team dinner event added to calendar: Berlin Offsite — Wed 19:00 at Katz Orange.
